row.notes: In Game_PitLane_ProjectBoxPose: mov r14d,edi (edi = box index, the pit lane record +0xe0) then mov r8,[rbx+r14*8+0x7f8], the box's cache slot, which holds a zone key: the 0x1445f32a0 result on [[mgr+0x18]+0x28] at the box position, a pointer to a 0x140-byte zone record or 0, which 0x140679340 only hashes (FNV-1a, 0x14063bc89) into the spline's segment buckets and never dereferences, so a wrong non-null value misses and falls back to the full search 0x140679410; null results are stored too, so a miss repeats; mov r14d,edi zero-extends the index, so it is unsigned 32-bit. Game_PitLane_GenerateSplines 0x1434ca550 zeroes 13 team slots at +0x790 and the 24 box slots at 0x7f8..0x8b7 (0x1434ca71b); 14 tuning handles follow at +0x8b8..+0x920 (0x1434ca85e), +0x928 is never written, and 27 16-byte entries {allocator, record pointer} run from +0x930 to +0xadf (bound at 0x1434b51cc), followed by the allocator at +0xae0 and component pointers. On a miss 0x1434c36a6 stores the lookup result back into [rbx+r14*8+0x7f8] unconditionally. Out of range: 24..37 read tuning handles, 38 the unwritten +0x928, 39 entry 0's allocator at +0x930 (non-null, so it is taken as a hit), 99 the component pointer at +0xb10 (set at 0x1434b5b6a), 0x7fffffff (the record reset value, 0x1434b56bc) mgr+0x4000007f0 and -1 mgr+0x8000007f0, which faults (0x1434c3656). Caller 0x1434be460 passes [rec+0xe0] unchecked; 0x1434c03c0 rejects only boxes above 0x17, signed (0x1434c0405). Core's pit box guard sends a box at or above its slot bound (pit_box_logic.hpp BOX_SLOTS) to site_Game_PitLane_BoxPoseFalse with edi = 2. Needs L2 promotion by the game owner.
